 How to watch Turkey vs Belgium
 Date: Thursday, November 12, 2026
 Time: 12 PM EDT
 Channel: FOX Sports 1
 Stream: Fubo ( try for free ) 
 Another international break has arrived, and tensions are high for UEFA Nations League rivals Turkey and Belgium as they meet under scary circumstances. Both teams are at risk of being relegated from the competition's top tier, though the Crescent Stars are in a considerably worse predicament after failing to pick up a point in four games thus far.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Anything but a home win over the Red Devils at Gursel Aksel Stadium on Thursday will guarantee a last-place finish in Group A1 and potentially automatic relegation. Belgium, meanwhile, sits six points better off in third place, just one point behind second-place Italy, and could still feasibly advance to the quarterfinals.
 Former Besiktas manager Sergen Yalcin will make his debut at the Turkish helm after Vincenzo Montella was relieved of his duties last month following three years in charge. Mark van Bommel has won two and lost two since assuming the Belgium post in the summer, most recently suffering a 4-1 humbling at France's hands at the start of October.
 Romeo Lavia picked up another caution in that defeat and will be suspended on Thursday, though Kevin De Bruyne and Youri Tielemans are each available after serving bans of their own against France. Turkey defender Abdulkerim Bardakci is suspended for the hosts, who are also without the injured quartet of Kenan Yildiz, Adil Demirbag, Mert Muldur and Aral Simsir.
